PASSES 2-4 AND 6 AND FAILS 1's SAME-ORIGIN CLAUSE - the ONLY corpus row carrying real gRPC-WEB WIRE CODE: protobuf-<hash>.js is @protobuf-ts/grpcweb-transport and holds application/grpc-web, application/grpc, X-Grpc-Web, grpc-status, grpc-message and grpc-timeout, which are exactly the strings this corpus had ZERO of. injective-proto-<hash>.js (3.4MB) is generated stubs for EIGHTEEN services - injective_accounts_rpc.InjectiveAccountsRPC, injective_spot_exchange_rpc.InjectiveSpotExchangeRPC, and the derivative_exchange, exchange, explorer, oracle, portfolio, campaign, megavault, rfq, rfq_gw, trading, archiver, auction, insurance, meta, referral and tc_derivatives RPCs. NO full RPC path is a literal anywhere in the bundle (a grep for /<pkg>.<Service>/<Method> over injective-proto returns 0): the transport composes it at call time as service.typeName + "/" + method.name, so a static scan names no endpoint and only running the code names any - and the same file refuses client-streaming and duplex as "not supported by grpc-web". 2 and 6 proven anonymously with SAFE GETs and a negative control against k8s.global.mainnet.explorer.grpc-web.injective.network: the real /injective_explorer_rpc.InjectiveExplorerRPC/GetTxByTxHash returns 405 (routed, POST-only) while the FABRICATED /zzz.NoSuchRPC/Nope and / both return 404 application/json 111B. FAILS 1's same-origin clause and records it rather than claiming a pass: helixapp.com/api answers 301 and every RPC host is a cross-origin *.grpc-web.injective.network, so this row is an @H subject whose protobuf backend is reached under a real SOP/CORS path rather than same-origin. STACK: Nuxt/Vite (<script type=module src=/_nuxt/<hash>.js> + 10 modulepreload chunks including injective-proto, protobuf, injective-sdk, injective-utils and injective-wallet, plus a non-module /chart/charting_library/charting_library.js, 8.5MiB total)

PASSES 1-4 AND 6, AND IS THE FLAGSHIP FOR 6 - the logged-out document names ELEVEN generated protobuf chunks by filename (base_snapshot_pb, group_pb, insights_pb, integration_pb, prebuild_pb, project_pb, runner_manager_pb, service_account_pb, team_pb, webhook_pb, workflow_pb) and NOT ONE service, method, message or field name is greppable in any of them: each holds a single base64 FileDescriptorProto that becomes names only after the page RUNS protobuf-es's descriptor decoder out of vendor-<hash>.js. Decoded, group_pb is gitpod/v1/group.proto package gitpod.v1 carrying SERVICE gitpod.v1.GroupService (14 methods - CreateGroup, GetGroup, ListGroups, UpdateGroup, DeleteGroup, CreateMembership, DeleteMembership, GetMembership and six more) and runner_manager_pb carries RunnerService (16), RunnerManagerService (6) and GatewayService (1). TRANSPORT IS CONNECT, NOT gRPC-WEB, and the row says so because the two are different wire formats: api-<hash>.js builds the client with baseUrl origin+"/api", useBinaryFormat:!1 and an Authorization Bearer interceptor, and vendor carries application/connect and application/proto while carrying NO application/grpc-web. 1, 2 and 6 proven anonymously with SAFE GETs plus a negative control: /api/gitpod.v1.GroupService/ListGroups?connect=v1&encoding=json&message=%7B%7D returns 401 application/json 89B {"code":"unauthenticated","message":"missing authorization header or cookie credentials"}, identically for RunnerService/ListRunners and UserService/GetAuthenticatedUser, while the FABRICATED /api/gitpod.v1.NoSuchService/Nope returns 404 text/plain "404 page not found" and a real path under a plain GET returns 415 - so the router separates real RPC paths from invented ones to an anonymous client, which is 2 proven on an endpoint set no grep can produce.
